title: 英超近20亿粉丝：过半俱乐部资不抵债，美式运营能救场吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The Premier League is the pinnacle of club football.
segments.zh: 英超是俱乐部足球的巅峰。

segments.en: The theatre, the tension and the talent are unrivaled in a league which boast nearly two billion followers worldwide and yet.
segments.zh: 戏剧性、紧张感和天赋在联赛中无与伦比，全球近20亿粉丝，然而。

segments.en: Now I'm not sure what would make you more miserable, being a Manchester United fan over the weekend or holding the stock this morning.
segments.zh: 现在我不确定什么会让你更痛苦，是周末当曼联球迷还是今早持有该权益资产。

segments.en: There's loads of losses that we look at the top five leagues of English football, more than half of them are technically insolvent.
segments.zh: 有很多亏损，我们看英格兰足球前五联赛，超过一半技术上资不抵债。

segments.en: Just look at how many clubs in the Premier League lost money in 2023 to 2024.
segments.zh: 看看2023到2024年英超有多少俱乐部亏损。

segments.en: Only a handful of them actually managed to turn a profit.
segments.zh: 只有少数几家实际实现了盈利。

segments.en: I've had the executive say to me, we're looking like behind the sofa, we're looking everywhere to get you know few pounds dollars or whatever.
segments.zh: 有高管对我说，我们像在沙发后找，到处找几英镑美元什么的。

segments.en: They're also looking overseas. One of the things that English football clubs have started to realise on the backs of what's been learnt here in America
segments.zh: 他们也在关注海外。英格兰足球俱乐部开始意识到，基于在美国学到的东西，

segments.en: is that people are willing to pay for experience.
But some fans are worried they're being left behind.
segments.zh: 但一些粉丝担心他们被落下。

segments.en: So the corporates who are running our clubs are making the decisions, we are just customers and we can only be forward in that way.
segments.zh: 所以运营我们俱乐部的是企业，他们做决定，我们只是顾客，只能这样往前看。

segments.en: As clubs explore new opportunities to keep the money flowing in, does English football need greater American influence to keep it afloat?
segments.zh: 随着俱乐部探索新机会来保持资金流入，英格兰足球是否需要更大的美国影响力来维持运转？

segments.en: And if so, what might that mean for the future of the beautiful game?
segments.zh: 如果是这样，这对美丽运动的未来可能意味着什么？
